svg.title: Attest — architecture
svg.text: How a close actually runs
MERCHANT RECORDS → PROOF, IN NINE STAGES
Your records

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Settlements, bank statement, orders, refunds, courier remittance, disputes. Seven

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sources; two are enough to start.
Ingest and normalise

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every amount becomes integer paise. No float ever touches money, because floats

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: manufacture the sub-rupee drift we exist to find.
Identity resolution

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bank credits are tied to batches by settlement_id — the authoritative key — never by

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: amount or by the bank's own UTR.
Deterministic engine

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rules, not guesses. Builds a proof chain per line: order to fee to tax to batch to bank

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: credit. Break one link, the line is unproven.
AI Finance Controller

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chooses what to investigate next, one step at a time. It can call tools. It cannot

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: compute money, write records, or certify anything.
14 deterministic tools

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every figure the controller reports came from one of these. The model narrates; the

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tools decide what is true.
Adversarial auditor

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six hypotheses that attack the matches that passed. 68.2% of them do not survive.
Policy gate

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Residual over 25 bps, or unexplained exceptions, means NOT ATTESTABLE. No action

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: available to the AI can override this.
Sealed close pack

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Proof rate, exceptions ranked by rupee, claim deadlines, and a SHA-256 of the whole

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: document.
